page.title: Technology work organized around the problem you need to solve.
page.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works builds, improves, connects, and administers practical digital systems without forcing every need into a custom platform.

items.name: Websites
items.description: Lightweight, accessible business websites with maintainable source, sensible hosting, clear ownership, and a deliberate handoff.
problems: Your current site is dated, hard to use, or difficult to update safely.
The site is slow, inaccessible, or more complicated than the business needs.
items.boundary: LDW keeps the platform proportional to the requirement. A CMS, database, analytics stack, or custom application is added only when it earns its place.

items.name: Website Care
items.description: Bounded ongoing maintenance and improvement for websites that need a clear owner for upkeep without turning into an oversized managed-service contract.
problems: Updates and small fixes are handled inconsistently.
Accessibility, dependencies, or performance need periodic attention.
The owner wants a documented path for routine improvements.
items.boundary: Website Care is scoped ongoing work, not a 24/7 help desk, ranking guarantee, or unlimited development subscription.

items.name: Business Systems & Automation
items.description: Practical workflow improvement across the tools a business already uses, with custom applications reserved for gaps that configuration and integration cannot solve well.
problems: A repeated task is still being done by hand.
Information is copied between disconnected tools.
An existing SaaS product almost fits but needs better configuration or integration.
examples: Focused internal tools or custom applications when justified
items.boundary: LDW checks native features, maintained integrations, and existing SaaS before custom building. Automation does not become a second source of truth.

items.name: Digital Ownership & Platform Administration
items.description: Inventory, transition, and administer critical digital assets so the business retains control while outside providers use named, appropriately scoped access.
problems: Nobody is sure who owns the domain, DNS, hosting, repository, or business profile.
A vendor or employee transition leaves uncertain access behind.
Routine platform administration has no clear owner or recovery path.
examples: Domain, DNS, hosting, repository, and business-profile transitions
Vendor offboarding, recovery, rollback, and handoff documentation
items.boundary: LDW does not store customer master passwords or recovery secrets as a substitute for platform-supported ownership and delegated access.

items.name: Technology Consulting
items.description: Architecture, troubleshooting, platform selection, and technical planning for organizations that need a clear decision before they need another tool.
problems: The team is choosing between platforms or vendors.
A technical problem has become difficult to isolate.
Leadership needs a practical roadmap rather than a broad MSP or product sale.
examples: Cost, ownership, security, and maintainability tradeoffs
items.boundary: Recommendations are sized to the decision at hand. LDW does not present consulting as a certification, compliance attestation, or guarantee of business results.

startingPoints.title: Improve what already exists
startingPoints.description: Keep the useful pieces, find the friction, and modernize only where the change earns its cost.

startingPoints.title: Untangle ownership or vendors
startingPoints.description: Identify who controls critical assets and access, then plan the safest practical transition.

startingPoints.title: Remove one repeated pain point
startingPoints.description: Start with one workflow or decision that costs real time before considering a larger system.

platformNote.title: Not every project needs a platform.
platformNote.body: Static hosting, open formats, portable repositories, native integrations, and low recurring costs are preferred when they meet the requirement. Databases, authentication services, paid SaaS, or custom applications should earn their place.
